name: CDexVerifierRequirements
title: CDex Verifier Requirements
description: This [Requirements](https://hl7.org/fhir/R5/requirements.html) resource lists all the CDex Verifier requirements defined in the narrative sections of this IG.

statement.requirement: [To verify the identity of the entity signing the Bundle or QuestionnaireResponse] One of the certificate Subject Alternative Name (SAN)) **SHALL** match `Signature.who.identifier` to verify the identity of the entity signing
[To verify the identity of the entity signing the Bundle or QuestionnaireResponse] The `"srCms"` Signer Commitments header ids **SHALL** match the `Signature.type.code` elements.
[To verify the identity of the entity signing the Bundle or QuestionnaireResponse] The `"sigT"` header timestamp  **SHALL** match `Signature.when`
[To verify the identity of the entity signing the Bundle or QuestionnaireResponse.] The certificate Issuer **SHOULD** be a trusted CA for the Consumer
[To verify the identity of the entity signing the Bundle or QuestionnaireResponse] The certificate KeyUsage **SHOULD** include 'DigitalSignature'
[To verify the identity of the entity signing the Bundle or QuestionnaireResponse] The certificate Validity Dates **SHOULD** be appropriate/long enough as determined by the business partners
